k:称.mnemonic: She adjusts her hairpin (𠂉) for a second (秒), and then the herald announces her full name and title to the hall. Appellation (praise, name, title).
k:称.hint: Herald announcing her to the hall.

k:異.mnemonic: A well (井) dug right in the middle of a rice field (田) that is already under water. Passers-by stop and stare at the oddity. Uncommon (different, strangeness, wonderful).
k:異.hint: A well in a flooded paddy.

k:津.mnemonic: The harbour clerk's brush (聿) notes down each boat that comes in to shelter from the tsunami (氵) beyond the sea wall. Haven (port, harbor, ferry).
k:津.hint: Boats logged in, safe from waves.

k:紀.mnemonic: A record written year after year on a long strip that coils like a cobra (已), each strip stitched to the next with thread (糸). Chronicle (account, narrative, history).

k:買.mnemonic: A net on top and a shell coin underneath: you hand over the coin and the goods go into your shopping net. Buy.
k:買.hint: Net bag over a shell coin.

k:清.mnemonic: Water so clear it shows blue (青) right to the bottom, as if a tsunami (氵) had rinsed every speck of mud away. Pure (purify, cleanse, exorcise).
k:清.hint: Water clear to the blue bottom.

k:遠.mnemonic: The path (辶) is so long that you pack a spare garment (衣) and food for your mouth (口), and still arrive with the soil (土) of many lands on your boots. Distant (far).

k:望.mnemonic: The old king is deceased (亡), and for a month (月) the prince gazes up at the full moon, dreaming of the day he will be king (王). Ambition (full moon, hope, desire).

k:逮.mnemonic: The servant (隶) runs off with the silver, and the constable sprints down the path (辶) after him and grabs him by the collar. Apprehend (chase).

k:笑.mnemonic: Two crinkled eyes like bamboo (竹) leaves over a big (大) open grin: the farmer has just seen how much grain (禾) his field gave this year. Laugh.

k:価.mnemonic: The leader (亻) brings back a strange object from the west (西), and the market crowd argues over what it is worth. Value (price).

k:働.mnemonic: The leader (亻) puts his power (力) into the job all day (日), lifting ten thousand (万) bricks before sunset. Work.

k:宅.mnemonic: Under your own roof (宀) there is a fishhook (乙) by the door, where you hang your coat the moment you come in. Home (house, residence).
k:宅.hint: Coat hook by your own door.

k:渡.mnemonic: The ferry with its canopy (广) carries you over the river, swollen by the tsunami (氵), then goes back to carry the next passenger across also (又). Transit (ford, ferry, cross).
k:渡.hint: Covered ferry going back and forth.

k:専.mnemonic: For ten (十) generations this family has done one thing only: taking the measurement (寸) of each rice field (田). Nobody does it better. Specialty (exclusive, mainly, solely).

k:博.mnemonic: Years of study in one specialty (専), and then the final drop (丶) of ink: the seal on the certificate that changes the title before your name. Dr. (Ph.D., esteem, win acclaim).

k:介.mnemonic: A fish tries to wear a hat (𠆢), but it is too tight and its fins (ハ) are pinned underneath, sticking out below the brim. Jammed in (shellfish, mediate).

k:除.mnemonic: The guard on the mound (阝) says: 'Show (示) your pass, now (今).' You have none, so he crosses you off the list and you stay outside. Exclude (remove, abolish, cancel).
k:除.hint: No pass, crossed off the list.

k:導.mnemonic: Someone who knows the road (道) walks a measurement (寸) ahead of you, holding the lamp and pointing out each turn. Guidance (leading, conduct, usher).

k:頃.mnemonic: The recipe page (頁) gives no exact amount. It just says a spoon (匕) or so, added at roughly the right moment. About (approximate time, toward, time).

k:労.mnemonic: Beads of sweat sparkle (⺌) on the forehead (冖) of a man putting all his power (力) into the digging. Labor (toil, trouble, reward for).

k:固.mnemonic: Stir the mixture ten (十) times (回) round and leave it in the box. By morning it has set like stone. Harden (set, clot, curdle).

k:個.mnemonic: When the crowd wavers, the leader (亻) lets his resolve harden (固) and steps out from the group, standing as one person on his own. Individual.

k:並.mnemonic: Three (三) cattle are tied to each stick (｜) of the fence, their horns (丷) all poking up along the top in a neat line. Row (and, besides, line up).

k:評.mnemonic: The judges walk along the row (並) of entries and say (言) what they think of each one in turn. Evaluate (criticism, comment).

k:貴.mnemonic: The guild owns just one (一) golden stick (｜). Each member (員) may hold it once in their life, and only with gloves on. Precious (value, prize, esteem).

k:遺.mnemonic: At the end of his path (辶) the old man hands his most precious (貴) things to those who will walk on after him. Bequeath (leave behind, reserve).
k:遺.hint: Handing treasures on at road's end.

k:宇.mnemonic: The edge of the roof (宀) juts out past the wall, so that you stay dry (干) while you stand at the door fumbling for your key. Eaves (roof, house, heaven).
k:宇.hint: Sheltered at the door in rain.

k:展.mnemonic: A garment (衣) folded in three (三) is shaken out and spreads wide, like a flag (尸) opening in the wind. Unfold (expand).

k:億.mnemonic: The leader (亻) has an idea (意) so good that he is sure every person in the country will buy one, and he counts the coins in advance. Hundred million (10**8).
k:億.hint: One idea, a whole country buying.
